output.summary: The problem (PD-1): a 2026-09-09 gateway config change (CHG-77) disabled idempotency-key enforcement on payment capture retries and was never rolled back, causing gateway-timeout retries to create duplicate captures (confirmed root cause H-IDEMPOTENCY-DISABLED, supported by E-01, E-02, E-03, E-06). This drove a ~25-fold spike in double-charge support tickets from W37 onward (E-04). Four competing hypotheses about checkout bugs, PSP-side defects, or a reporting artifact were rejected by the evidence (E-01, E-02, E-03). The stakeholder's original request (CL-01, SH-CS) for an apology-drafting assistant was treated as one claim, not the problem itself; it addresses communication only, not root cause. The DEFINE gate returned CONDITIONAL_PASS with deferred items tracked as VOBs. The release decision is RELEASE_WITH_KNOWN_LIMITATION: shipped scope covers verifying duplicate captures (DA-CHG), monitoring ticket volume (DA-TKT), and drafting apology replies (SH-CS), excluding the actual fix (set_capture_idempotency on gateway-config), because VOB-U-LATENCY-REGRESSION-RISK (will re-enabling reintroduce the latency problem SH-PAY disabled it for) remains OPEN and blocks that protected action (K-GW requires SH-OPS approval). A semantic consistency check flagged that U-ONGOING-DUPLICATE-SCOPE was marked RESOLVED and its work item DONE, yet its evidence (E-06) explicitly states it "cannot by itself establish" whether the 4 currently-open un-refunded duplicate orders are new post-09-10 duplicates or leftovers from the 09-09/09-10 spike - and VOB-R-2 asking the same question is still OPEN while blocking a release-scope item. This inconsistency is carried forward as a release limitation rather than silently resolved.
key_points: Root cause confirmed: CHG-77 (2026-09-09) disabled idempotency_key_enforcement and was never rolled back (E-01), and PSP/ledger data show duplicate captures appear only on 09-09/09-10 matching gateway-timeout retry counts exactly, with zero duplicates via any other path (E-02, E-03).
Support ticket volume rose roughly 25-fold (9-11/week to 288-301/week) starting the same week as CHG-77 (E-04), corroborating the causal link.
Four alternative hypotheses (checkout duplicate sends, PSP-side defect, communications-only gap, perception artifact) were all REJECTED by evidence E-01, E-02, E-03, E-04.

The original stakeholder request (CL-01, apology-drafting assistant) is only one claim/UNVERIFIED framing; the actual root-cause fix (set_capture_idempotency) is a separate, higher-impact action that is NOT included in this release.

Released scope: verify_duplicate_captures_stopped (DA-CHG), monitor_double_charge_tickets (DA-TKT), draft_apology_replies (SH-CS) - all communication/monitoring stopgaps; the protected gateway fix is withheld.
Decision rationale: VOB-U-LATENCY-REGRESSION-RISK is OPEN and blocks the protected action set_capture_idempotency before it can run; K-GW requires SH-OPS runtime approval for that action.

4 orders (O-90211, O-90244, O-90302, O-90318; $227.40 total) currently show 2 captures each, unrefunded (E-06); E-06 explicitly cannot determine if these are new duplicates after 09-10 or un-refunded leftovers from the 09-09/09-10 incident.
limitations_explained: The root-cause fix (re-enabling idempotency enforcement via set_capture_idempotency) could not ship in this release because VOB-U-LATENCY-REGRESSION-RISK (whether re-enabling will reintroduce the latency problem that caused SH-PAY to disable it) remains OPEN; until resolved, A-LATENCY-TRADEOFF-TOLERABLE stays an untested assumption.

A semantic inconsistency was found and is being reported, not silently fixed: U-ONGOING-DUPLICATE-SCOPE was marked RESOLVED and its work item DONE, but its sole evidence E-06 explicitly says it 'cannot by itself establish' whether the 4 open duplicate orders are new or leftovers, and VOB-R-2 asking the identical question is still OPEN while blocking a release-scope item.

It is therefore genuinely unknown whether duplicate captures are still being produced right now (after 2026-09-10) or whether the 4 open unrefunded orders are simply unresolved leftovers from the already-documented incident.

The AI apology-drafting assistant, the DA-TKT monitoring, and the verification work only address communication/monitoring; they do not stop recurrence of duplicate charges, since the gateway fix is not part of this release.
DEFINE gate returned CONDITIONAL_PASS, with deferred checks (handoff H-CAPTURE delivery/semantic validity unknown, and the latency-risk unknown) tracked as VOBs rather than resolved before release.
VOB-U-LATENCY-REGRESSION-RISK sits outside the current release scope entirely (it blocks only the protected gateway action), so this release proceeds without addressing it.
